title: Megha Mandara
desc: A pregnant woman goes into shock after hearing the news of her husband's accidental death. The man miraculously survives and returns to his wife who remains catatonic after losing her child.

title: Preethsu Thappenilla
desc: A happy-go-lucky man falls head over heels in love with a girl at first sight. By a twist of fate, they become victims of a tragic incident, which takes their relationship to the next level.

title: Johnny Johnny Yes Papa
desc: Johnny, along with his father, works for social causes under the pretext of a software management firm. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he meets Priya and falls for her.

title: Boss
desc: Ram and Raj are estranged twins. When Raj learns that Ram has been mysteriously murdered, he sets out to avenge his death.

title: Jogi The King
desc: After a crime lord is murdered by Madesha, Nivedhitha, a journalist, sets out to meet him. She ends up meeting an old woman and promises to help her find her son, who is none other than Madesha.
